recognize_zh: 兩顆分葉核嗜中性球的核葉旁各有一個小圓形染色質團，以一條細絲與主核相連（紅箭頭），形似鼓槌，就是女性不活化 X 染色體所形成的鼓槌小體（drumstick）。
features: Two mature segmented neutrophils with fine lilac cytoplasmic granules
Small (about 1.5 µm), round, dense chromatin appendage attached to a nuclear lobe by a thin chromatin strand (red arrows)
Appendage has a solid, well-defined head (drumstick) rather than a hollow or unattached body
Background red cells normocytic with a few target cells and stomatocyte-like forms; platelets present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature segmented neutrophils, each bearing a small round, densely staining nuclear appendage connected to a nuclear lobe by a fine chromatin filament. The appendages have a solid head consistent with drumsticks (sex chromatin, Barr body equivalent). Red cells show a few target cells but no other significant abnormality. Findings are consistent with neutrophil drumsticks, a normal finding in females representing the inactivated X chromosome.

ddx.vs: Sessile nodules lack a thin stalk and lie directly on the lobe, and are not counted as drumsticks.
Racquets have a hollow, pale-centered head, unlike the solid dense head of a drumstick.
Hypersegmentation shows six or more full-size lobes rather than a single small appendage.
Döhle bodies are pale blue cytoplasmic patches and platelets are granular and not connected to the nucleus by a chromatin thread.
